title: CloudPilotExecutionFeatureRecord
description: Schema for CloudPilot stage execution records used for historical profiling and ML prediction.

stage_id.description: Stage name / identifier within the DAG

stage_type.description: Genomic or processing stage type (e.g. vcf_stats, filtering, variant_processing, feature_extraction, analysis)

workload_id.description: Genomic chunk or workload identifier (e.g. chr22_small_100s, chr22_medium_500s, chr22_large_full)

workload_source.description: Origin of the workload: genomic, simulated, or phase1_test

region_size.description: Genomic region size in base pairs (end - start)

variant_count.description: Total number of genomic variants in the input chunk

sample_count.description: Number of genomic sample genotypes in the input chunk

dataset_size_mb.description: Compressed size of the genomic dataset chunk in megabytes

worker_count.description: Number of concurrent workers or threads allocated

runtime_seconds.description: Total duration of stage execution in seconds

actual_cpu.description: Measured CPU core seconds or usage

actual_memory_mb.description: Measured peak resident memory in megabytes
